content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question: can the module [article_no] be connected to a PC running Windows and accessible via web browser for display purposes?

I'm sorry, but your question seems unclear. The module [article_no] is a digital expansion module and cannot be connected to a Windows PC or a web server, because it does not include web server functionality. Please clarify your specific requirements.

Since the mentioned extension module is used with a [product_name] basis module, I assume you have such a module. All [product_name] basis modules include a web server, which can access the I/O of your extension module as well. You can utilize this web server from a browser on your PC. Tip: You can activate the web server via navigation: Tools > Transfer > Access control.
Apologies, my earlier reference was incorrect. I actually meant the module [article_no], which is a basis module. Does this basis module support web server functionality?

The basis module with order number [article_no] features two integrated web servers: 1) A simple web server that provides a virtual [product_name] display and a virtual operator display—no physical operator display is required. These virtual displays show programmed messages and can use cursor and function keys for switching purposes. 2) An extended web server for custom user-defined web pages, which can be created using [product_name] Web Editor software. This allows you to add switches, buttons, analog input/output fields, and more for advanced monitoring and control.
Thank you for your assistance. Could you explain why an SD card is needed in the basis module when enabling web server features?

Projects created with the [product_name] Web Editor must be stored on the SD card, which must be inserted in the [product_name] basis module for the web server functionality to access custom web pages.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are exploring how modules can connect to PCs and utilize web server features, with early misunderstandings clarified to focus on the [product_name] basis module, which provides integrated web servers for browser-based monitoring and control. There is also interest in understanding why an SD card is required for using custom web server pages made with the [product_name] Web Editor.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek straightforward web server access from the [product_name] basis module via PC browser, and want clear information regarding the necessity of an SD card for enabling advanced web server features.
